final: WITH disease_counts AS (SELECT p.Diagnosis AS disease, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.Diagnosis), total AS (SELECT SUM(disease_count) AS total_count FROM disease_counts), average AS (SELECT AVG(disease_count) AS avg_count FROM disease_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT disease, disease_count, CAST(disease_count AS REAL) / total_count, disease_count - avg_count FROM disease_counts CROSS JOIN total CROSS JOIN average WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL AND avg_count IS NOT NULL AND disease_count > avg_count
